lastCompletedGameRecap.recapHeadline: Dak Prescott accounts for 5 TDs as the Cowboys roll to a 51-30 victory over the Titans
lastCompletedGameRecap.recapLeadExcerpt: ARLINGTON, Texas -- — When one touchdown became two and three and so on, all the way to six, Dak Prescott said the conversation was the same for the offense of the Dallas Cowboys : Just keeping doing it.  So they did.  Prescott threw four touchdown passes and ran for a score, and the Cowboys reached the end zone on their first six drives while scoring on all eight possessions before kneeling once at the end of a 51-30 victory over the Tennessee Titans on Sunday.  “It was just constant communication all game from all 11 of us, or whoever’s in the game, of keep pushing it, ‘We did it. This time it was in the Dallas play-calling debut of veteran coach Mike Pettine , who took over those duties from 34-year-old Christian Parker , the youngest defensive coordinator in club history.  Parker was essentially demoted after a 46-40 loss to San Francisco in which the Cowboys gave up the most yards in a home game in franchise history (584).

irReserve.name: Zack Baun
factors: On Injured Reserve — 21-day practice window not yet opened
irReserve.beatComment: Baun was held out of practice all week due to a back injury that he sustained against the Giants in Week 9. The injury is severe enough for him to require a stint on IR, which means he'll miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 15 against the Seahawks. Jeremiah Trotter figures to start alongside Jihaad Campbell at inside linebacker moving forward, beginning with Sunday's home tilt against the Steelers.

irReserve.name: Dontayvion Wicks
factors: Coaching/beat report confirms player will not be activated from IR this week
irReserve.beatComment: Wicks missed the three games before the Eagles' Week 10 bye due to an ankle injury, and he was limited during Week 11 prep before the team tacked on a foot issue on Friday's practice report, after which he was ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Steelers. Per Tim McManus of ESPN.com, Wicks sustained the foot injury Friday, and it presumably led to his placement on IR. Wicks will be sidelined until at least Philadelphia's Week 15 matchup with Seattle on Saturday, Dec. 19.

coachingMatchup.headline: Brian Schottenheimer & DC Christian Parker vs. HC Nick Sirianni, OC Sean Mannion & DC Vic Fangio (AT&T Stadium)
coachingMatchup.summary: Week 12 two-sided coordinator chess match pitting Dallas Cowboys's staff (Brian Schottenheimer, OC Klayton Adams, DC Christian Parker) against Philadelphia Eagles (3-7)—testing both Dallas's offensive efficiency and its defensive pass-rush and coverage discipline.
bullets: Pass-Game Efficiency & Coverage Shell Delta: Brian Schottenheimer and OC Klayton Adams pair condensed splits with pre-snap jet motion and orbit motion to stress Philadelphia Eagles's single-high vs. two-high rotations—widening curl/flat defenders to attack the honey-hole between hook/curl linebackers and deep safeties on play-action choice/dagger concepts.

Trench Run-Fit & Two-Way Leverage: Against Philadelphia Eagles's pin-and-pull, counter, and duo runs targeting the A- and B-gaps, DC Christian Parker balances four-man pressure with disguised Quarters and Cover 6 split-safety rotations on early downs and in the red zone.

Money-Down & Red-Zone Execution: Third-down conversion discipline and red-zone touchdown rate govern whether Dallas sustains multi-play scoring drives or yields momentum to Philadelphia Eagles's pass rush and coverage disguises.
Tempo, Turnovers & Venue Leverage: AT&T Stadium situational play-calling, penalty margin, and turnover differential provide the clearest late-game swing factors for both coaching staffs.

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Dak Prescott, Brevyn Spann-Ford & CeeDee Lamb vs. S Marcus Epps & LB Nolan Smith Jr.
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: DAL: #2 Pass Off (270.9 yds) · #2 Off. Scoring (+8.90) | PHI: #21 Pass Def (+2.90)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Dak Prescott, Brevyn Spann-Ford & CeeDee Lamb attack the intermediate seams and middle-of-the-field leverage windows against Philadelphia Eagles's #21 pass defense (+2.90). Winning early-down timing throws keeps Dallas's offense ahead of the chains and punishes disguised single-high rotations.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch Dak Prescott (#4) scanning Eagles's deep safeties at the snap—when LB Nolan Smith Jr. widens to take away the crossers, the intermediate seam opens immediately for Brevyn Spann-Ford (#89).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Quinnen Williams, Kenny Clark & Otito Ogbonnia vs. QB Joe Milton & OT Jordan Mailata
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: DAL: #16 Def Sacks (2.3/gm) | PHI: #16 Pass Protection (6.5%)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Quinnen Williams, Kenny Clark & Otito Ogbonnia lead Dallas's #16 NFL pass rush (2.3/gm) against Philadelphia Eagles's #16 pass-protection unit (6.5%). Collapsing the interior pocket without sending extra blitzers lets Cowboys keep seven defenders in coverage.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: On 3rd-and-6+, watch whether Quinnen Williams (#92) draw chip help from Eagles's tight ends or backs—creating 1-on-1 rush lanes inside for Kenny Clark (#97).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Caleb Downs, Jalen Thompson & Cobie Durant vs. WR DeVonta Smith & QB Joe Milton
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: DAL: #30 Pass Def (+6.00) | PHI: #28 Pass Off (166.8 yds)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Caleb Downs, Jalen Thompson & Cobie Durant anchor Dallas's #30 pass defense (+6.00) against WR DeVonta Smith and Philadelphia Eagles's #28 passing attack (166.8 yds). Limiting explosive 20+ yard chunk plays forces Eagles into sustained red-zone drives.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Track Caleb Downs (#13) at the top of routes against WR DeVonta Smith: press-bail alignment with safety help over the top takes away QB Joe Milton's preferred isolation shots.

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Javonte Williams & Hunter Luepke vs. Eagles Front Seven & LB Nolan Smith Jr.
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: DAL: #20 Rush Off (107.5 yds) | PHI: #26 Rush Def (+0.19)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Javonte Williams & Hunter Luepke test Philadelphia Eagles's #26 run defense (+0.19) with horizontal stretch and interior cutback lanes. Generating 4.5+ yards on first down unlocks play-action explosives and neutralizes Eagles's pass-rush packages.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch whether Eagles's linebackers over-pursue motion to the perimeter—opening decisive backside B-gap cutback lanes for Javonte Williams (#33).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Cooper Beebe, Tyler Smith & Terence Steele vs. DT Jalen Carter & Eagles Simulated Pressures
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: DAL: #16 Pass Protection (6.0%) | PHI: #16 Def Sacks (2.4/gm)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Cooper Beebe, Tyler Smith & Terence Steele protect Dak Prescott (#16 protection at 6.0%) against DT Jalen Carter and Philadelphia Eagles's #16 pass rush (2.4/gm). Passing off interior twists and simulated blitzes cleanly determines late-down conversion efficiency.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch Cooper Beebe (#56) on obvious passing downs—if DT Jalen Carter cannot win clean around the arc, Eagles must dial up interior stunts that stress Tyler Smith (#73).
